title: Atlas Stats
description: This Plugin brings a new way of viewing and sharing your Player Stats with anyone on the server, you can view such things as Kills, Deaths, EXP, LEVEL, Blocks Mined, Ores Mined, And Every Mob Killed.
body:
# AtlasStats

AtlasStats provides a clean and interactive way to view and share player statistics across your server. Players can track everything from kills and deaths to mined blocks and mob statistics, all through an easy to use GUI.

It also includes a toggleable compass display above the hotbar that shows useful real-time information.

---

## Features

- Full player statistics GUI  
- Public stat sharing in chat  
- View your own or other players' stats  
- Server statistics command  
- Toggleable compass overlay above the hotbar  
- Tracks blocks mined, ores, mobs killed, and more  
- Fully configurable messages and menus  

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|------------|
| `/astats help` | Show all commands | `atlasstats.help` |
| `/astats stats` | Open your stats GUI | None |
| `/astats statsspy <player>` | View another player's stats | `atlasstats.statsspy` |
| `/astats reloadconfig` | Reload config files | `atlasstats.reloadconfig` |
| `/astats serverstats` | View server statistics | `atlasstats.serverstats` |
| `/astats compass` | Toggle compass display | None |

---

## How It Works

- Use `/astats stats` to open your personal stats menu  
- Click any stat to send it into public chat  
- Use `/astats statsspy <player>` to view other players  
- Toggle the compass display to see coordinates and info in real time  

---

## Tracked Stats

AtlasStats tracks a wide range of data including:

- Player kills and deaths  
- Experience and levels  
- Distance traveled  
- Blocks and ores mined  
- Mob kills across all dimensions  
- Damage dealt and taken  
- Raid statistics and more  

---

## Server Stats

The `/astats serverstats` command provides:

- Server IP and port  
- Player count  
- Server version  
- RAM usage  
- TPS and lag information  

---

## Configuration

The plugin is fully customizable through configuration files:

- Command messages  
- GUI titles and layouts  
- Compass display format  
- Stat categories and formatting  

All values can be edited to match your server style.

---

## Notes

- Works out of the box with minimal setup  
- Designed to be lightweight and efficient  
- All messages and menus support full customization  

---

## Support

For help or suggestions, join the Discord:  
https://discord.gg/f9swPR7NnV

---

AtlasStats adds a simple and powerful way to track and share player progress on your server.
